title_zh: AGY Roundtable v5.5.0 — 长上下文压缩、SQLite FTS5、VLM 自动审图、Worktree 并行写盘、极致流畅度与零弹窗
title_en: AGY Roundtable v5.5.0 — Long-Context Compression, SQLite FTS5, VLM Figure QA, Git Worktree & Zero-Freeze Runtime
highlights_zh: 长上下文压缩引擎（v5.3/v5.4）：三区 KV-Cache 稳定前缀、观测块外置折叠、不可变轮次状态卡、单次峰值水位校准与超限无损换乘
跨任务 SQLite FTS5 中英双语全文检索 + 纯标准库 AST 代码结构图谱（RepoMap）
顶刊科研绘图双门禁：PNG/TIFF/SVG/CSV 反伪造校验 + 自动 VLM 视觉看图自修闭环（最多 2 轮）+ .drawio 导出
Git Worktree 并行隔离写盘与冲突安全合并、可选匿名互评 + Borda 计票、单任务 Token 硬熔断
极致流畅度与调用韧性：线性 O(N) 零 ReDoS Markdown 解析 + LRU 缓存、/api/state?slim=1 + 304/gzip（-96% 流量）、零空闲刷盘、动态推理超时与思考心跳、只读策略受阻自动跨引擎切替补
Codex 可配置改文件权限（全局上限 / 成员卡片一键切换 / 批量授权 / 圆桌可写开关）与 Windows 全链路零黑框弹窗
内置版本更新自动检测弹窗：每次发布新版本自动提醒老版本并标注当前/最新版本
highlights_en: Long-context compression engine: KV-cache stable 3-zone prefix, observation masking, immutable round snapshots, peak occupancy calibration & lossless rollover
Cross-task bilingual SQLite FTS5 memory index & pure-stdlib AST Structural RepoMap
Dual-gate publication Figure QA: pure-stdlib PNG/TIFF/SVG/CSV anti-fabrication checks + automated VLM visual critique & bounded self-repair loop + editable .drawio export
Native Git Worktree parallel write isolation & safe merge, optional anonymous peer review with Borda voting, and per-task token budget cap
Zero-freeze & resilient calling: linear O(N) zero-ReDoS Markdown + LRU cache, slim 304/gzip state polling (-96% payload), zero idle disk writes, effort-aware idle watchdog & thinking heartbeats
Configurable Codex file-edit permissions (global ceiling, 1-click member pills, batch toggle, roundtable write opt-in) & Win32 zero-popup subprocesses
Automatic update notification modal alerting older installations & cached browser tabs whenever a new version ships
